options.description: The tenant console: listener, state folder and tenant origins.
options.name: core

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_DATA_ROOT: The state folder: master.key (seals the stored secrets) and the platform delivery (seed, verified images).
settings.name: dataRoot

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL_FILE: The console Postgres URL (a mounted secret file); every record of the console lives there.
settings.name: databaseUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_PORTAL_DIR: The tenant portal bundle (defaults to the shipped admin/tenant-portal/dist).
settings.name: portalDir

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_PORT: Port of the tenant listener.
settings.name: port

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_BASE_DOMAIN: Tenants are served at <tenant>.<baseDomain>.
settings.name: baseDomain

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_BIND: Address of the tenant listener.
settings.name: bind

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_EXTERNAL_SCHEME: Scheme browsers use for tenant origins.
settings.name: externalScheme

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_EXTERNAL_PORT: Port browsers use for tenant origins, when not the scheme default.
settings.name: externalPort

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_SECURE_COOKIE: Whether session cookies are Secure.
settings.name: secureCookie

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_TRUSTED_PROXY: Whether the tenant listener sits behind a trusted proxy.
settings.name: trustedProxy

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_SECRET_TTL_HOURS: Lifetime of issued tenant secrets, in hours.
settings.name: secretTtlHours

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_HEALTH_PROBE_MS: Interval of environment health probes, in milliseconds.
settings.name: healthProbeMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_HEALTH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS: Timeout of one environment health probe, in milliseconds.
settings.name: healthProbeTimeoutMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_CONSOLE_HOST: Browser host the console is served on through its Ingress.
settings.name: consoleHost

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_FINGERPRINT_KEY_FILE: The account-email fingerprint key (a mounted secret file).
settings.name: fingerprintKey

options.description: The HTTP rollout client to the platform agent channel (in-process rollout when off).
options.name: rollout

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_ROLLOUT_URL: Base URL of the platform agent channel.
settings.name: url

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_ROLLOUT_TOKEN: The bearer token of the hive on the agent channel.
settings.name: token

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_ROLLOUT_HIVE_ID: The hive the rollout client is bound to.
settings.name: hiveId

options.description: The injected tenant IdP the console connects to (a local IdP is used when off).
options.name: idp

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_BROWSER_BASE_URL: The browser-facing IdP origin (the issuer).
settings.name: browserBaseUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_BASE_URL: The in-cluster IdP origin for token, jwks and admin calls (defaults to browserBaseUrl).
settings.name: baseUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_CA_FILE: Path of the IdP CA certificate.
settings.name: caFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE: The IdP admin token (a mounted secret file, never an inline value).
settings.name: adminToken

options.description: TLS of the environment and IdP Ingresses this console renders.
options.name: ingressTls

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_INGRESS_TLS_SOURCE: existing-secret, cert-manager or development.
settings.name: source

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_INGRESS_TLS_SECRET: The TLS Secret (for existing-secret).
settings.name: secretName

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_INGRESS_TLS_ISSUER: The cert-manager ClusterIssuer (for cert-manager).
settings.name: clusterIssuer

roles.description: A tenant member who manages the tenant environments and their rollout (not access or settings).
roles.name: environment-admin
